Name: Vanilla Friendly Horse Recolor (AT)
Author: yuninocorn
Description:
[b][size=4]General[/size][/b]
This Content Pack utilizes the Alternative Textures framework to change your horse's appearance. There are 116 different color variations to choose from, each available with three different saddle colors and a bareback option. Along with most common horse color variations, I have added a few unicorn options. The mane colors of the rainbow ones shift in every frame when the horse moves for a little magical touch, as showcased in the videos tab of this mod page. 

I tried to keep the vanilla style as much as possible to make everything look cohesive. Feel free to suggest more color variations or any tweaks on the existing ones! 


[size=4][b]Changing your horse's appearance [/b][/size]
To select your horse's appearance, buy the scissors from Robin and use them on your horse. If you have the Horse Overhaul mod installed, you may need to temporarily disable the saddle bags to do this. Using the scissors on your horse should open up a menu displaying all the different horse variations. From there, you can just scroll down and select the one you prefer.
This will only change the appearance of the horse you used the scissors on, so if you have modded in multiple horses or are playing with friends, each horse can have a different appearance. 


[size=4][b]Installing (PC) [/b][/size]
To install this content pack, download the mod file and extract the .zip file to the 'Mods' folder in your Stardew Valley game folder. 

Enjoy the horses!
